control: SYNTHETIC POSITIVE CONTROL -- NOT REAL DATA, NEVER AN INPUT TO ANY MECHANISM
purpose: Proves the nyiso-163 gate has discriminating power: a gate that can never return PASS would trivially 'pass' the 2008 negative control while being useless. This fixture is the minimal shape of a row that WOULD identify, so the negative-control result means something.
WARNING: These rows are INVENTED for test purposes. The numbers are not NYISO parameters and must never be transcribed into a fixture of received rows, cited as evidence, or used to derive any model input. Real received rows go in a separate file with a real `source`.
provenance: Constructed at nyiso-163 by taking the 2008 Table B.4 LRR 3 shape (a forecast-load threshold, a minimum-units count, an enumerated unit set) and giving it a current vintage -- i.e. removing exactly the one blocker (nyiso-97 §4 blocker 2, vintage) that LRR 3 fails on and nothing else.
